newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-HANSAPANK GROUP JAN/FEB NET INCOME 94.5 MLN EEK.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-HANSAPANK GROUP JAN/FEB NET INCOME 94.5 MLN EEK.

text.p: Estonia's largest bank Hansapank on Thursday said its group net income for the first two months of the year was 94.5 million kroons.
The bank said in a statement that the shareholder equity increased 12.4 percent in the first two months, mainly due to the 94.5 million kroon net income for the period.
Hansapank also said that group deposits rose by 6.6 percent in the first two months of the year to 4.63 billion kroons.
Time deposits rose by 423.4 million kroons while demand deposits were down by 135.5 million kroons.
The loan portfolio rose by 325.3 million kroons to 4.0 billion kroons and the share of net loans in total assets rose to 50.7 percent versus 49.4 percent at the end of 1996.
The bank said that it set aside 68.2 million kroons for loan losses, or 1.7 percent of the total loan portfolio. The amount set aside at the end of last year was 58.9 million kroons.

The group also had 712.6 million kroons of securities available for resale on its books versus 659 million kroons at the end of last year although the amounts of securities held for investment fell to 52.8 million kroons from 77 million kroons.
Securities purchased under resale agreements fell to 200.6 million kroons from 309.4 million kroons.
